declared_dynamic_edges.reason: The event-source PostgreSQL proof resolves the registered Retrograde producer entrypoint itself so stale writer names fail the contract test.
The reranker artifact contract test imports a copy of the real cross-encoder source from a temporary checkout layout to prove same-named checkout model folders are never loaded.

The truncate-safety PostgreSQL test imports the real script fresh after pointing NEXUS_RUNTIME_CONFIG at a registry whose local_path is missing, because the script resolves its embedder registry when it loads a model. This edge is test-only: the script (and scripts/utils/embedding_utils.py through it) still has no operator entry point and is import-era tooling for #811.

The golden-query override test loads the V1 IR-evaluation CLI by file in a fresh interpreter to run its real override merge on the checked-in ir_eval/golden_queries.json. This edge is test-only: ir_eval/ir_eval.py (and the ir_eval/scripts modules it imports) still has no operator entry point.
The fixture-owned TEST provider database is seeded through the existing 008 operator's production seeder (issue 816). The numbered script is loaded by file.
The offline TEST database contract loads the 008 operator by file to prove story database names are refused before connecting (issue 816).
